title: A-B radial fall from r0 = 9: one run sweeps the full A-B force profile and tests the 1.41 pair ratio
pitch: Plumbline's radial fall (2026-11-24) covers A-A only. This is the A-B analogue: A at x=0.5 and B at x=9.5, both at rest on y=5 (r0 = 9.0), T = 12, tracker sample_dt 0.01. Known inputs: K_B/K_A = 1.41 (P-0025, r 4 to 8); A-A K(r) falls beyond r = 6 (H18). Prediction: one radial shape with the fixed 1.41 ratio holds in every 2-wide separation band from 9 down to contact. Falsifier: a fitted K_B/K_A that differs from 1.41 by more than 0.1 in any band between r = 2 and 9, or a far-range K_A(9) outside 11 to 13. Contact (r < 1) is excluded from the fit.
